posts.title: The Musk Movie -- October 26, 2026
posts.description: npr.org Alex Gibney's latest movie, Musk , disappeared from theaters and was blocked from buying ads on social media sites. Elon Musk is threatening to sue. I am going to see if I can find it on a streaming site.

posts.title: High Treason -- October 25, 2026
posts.description: listal.com I have seen some strange movies recently. High Treason was one of them. It was made in 1929. Like Alfred Hitchcock's Blackmail , it started being shot as a silent movie and became a talkie. Much of the silent footage was recycled with dubbing. The acting was enthusiastic. posts.title: Angela Lansbury 100 -- October 16, 2026
posts.description: listal.com Wildly talented actress, singer and dancer Angela Lansbury was born 100 years ago today, on 16-October-1925. She was one of the last links to old Hollywood. She could play good people and bad people, serious people and funny people, and animated tea pots. listal.com listal.com listal.com
